help_mdMazean is a multiplayer FPS game featuring robots armed with laser guns. Your goal is to disassemble other robots.
* Right click to aim (Beam sniper only)
* Q to throw a Flash grenade
* E to deploy a temporary Force-field
* Tap and hold to aim and shoot
* Move the joystick to its limit to sprint
* Tap the grenade icon to throw a Flash grenade
When spawning or respawning, you may select:
Regardless of which weapon you select, you may toss a Flash grenade which blinds and damages nearby players.
There are 4 unique crowns that you can find and pick up:
* Speed, which increase your movement speed
* Jump, which increases your jump height
* Health, which increases your damage resistance
* X-ray, which lets you see players through walls
Once a player has a crown, they keep it until they die.
You can deploy a temporary Force-field to block lasers and Flash grenade damage. Players and Flash grenades can fly right through.
Hide behind cover to avoid getting hit. Score a point for each enemy that you defeat.
Press Enter to focus the chat, type your message, and press Enter again to send. Remember to never share personal information in chat!
